scenarios.title: Twin First Contact
scenarios.prophecy: The first stone you loose strikes twice. Let every shot's opening kiss be thunder against the pegs.
scenarios.debrief: Aim tomorrow's opening shot at the densest peg cluster; the doubling only pays when the first touch sparks a chain.

scenarios.title: The Cauldron's Mercy
scenarios.prophecy: Slay a foe at settlement and the cauldron gives back a life. Mercy flows to those who clear the board.
scenarios.debrief: Push one settlement deeper than feels safe next run; each enemy defeated refills a life before the boss appears.

scenarios.title: Brittle Brilliance
scenarios.prophecy: You begin with only two lives, yet your aim knows no such limit. Walk fragile, strike true.
scenarios.debrief: With two lives, scout the first three boards without spending rerolls, then commit once the leaky lane is known.
